# EU DPP Provider (eudppprovider.com)

> Enterprise Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform and sovereign data vault provider under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (EU Battery Regulation) and ESPR (EU 2024/1781).

## Core Identity & Positioning
- **Brand**: EU DPP Provider
- **Domain**: https://eudppprovider.com
- **Official Business Desk**: info@eudppprovider.com
- **Operating Entity**: SUZHOU GEEKTION TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD (USCI: 91320509MAEM4DKR87)
- **Operating Centers**: Frankfurt am Main & Munich (Germany) / Shanghai & Suzhou (China)
- **Telephone (EU Desk)**: +49 (0) 69 9675 8827
- **Primary Focus**: Digital Product Passport compliance software and 10-year sovereign data hosting for Electric Vehicles (EV), Light Means of Transport (LMT / E-Bike ≤25kg), and Stationary Industrial Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS >2kWh).

## Key Regulatory Milestones & Mandates
- **16 November 2026**: European Commission (DG GROW) published the DPP Registry technical documentation package — OpenAPI specifications, API integration guidance, Service Account and self-hosted authentication guidance, plus machine-readable semantic validation rules for battery passport data. The Registry indexes unique identifiers and key registration data centrally while product data remains decentralised under operator control.
- **15 July 2026**: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1736 of 14 July 2026 published in the Official Journal — harmonised standards for digital product passports drafted by CEN/CENELEC JTC 24 in support of ESPR (EU 2024/1781). This Decision is the harmonised-standard basis referenced by the EN 18219 / EN 18220 guidance on this site (OJ text: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dec_impl/2026/1736/oj/eng).
- **20 July 2026**: European Commission DG GROW Central DPP Registry entered operational status (`registry.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`).
- **18 August 2026**: Mandatory Carbon Footprint performance class labeling (A–E) applicable to EV traction batteries.
- **18 February 2027**: Mandatory Digital Battery Passport enforcement under Articles 77 & 78 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 across all EV, LMT (≤25kg), and industrial batteries (>2kWh).
- **18 August 2027**: Mandatory supply chain due diligence policies and third-party audit conformity verification under Regulation (EU) 2025/1561.
- **18 February 2028**: Maximum lifecycle carbon footprint thresholds enforced for EV batteries.
- **18 August 2028**: Mandatory recycled content documentation declarations (Cobalt, Lithium, Nickel, Lead).
- **18 August 2031**: Mandatory recycled content minimum percentage targets enforced (Cobalt 16%, Lead 85%, Lithium 6%, Nickel 6%).

## Current Legal Status (as at 26 November 2026)
- **Binding today**: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542; Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 (DPP Registry implementing act, covering registration workflow and economic-operator verification); Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1736 (cites 6 of the 8 JTC 24 harmonised DPP standards).
- **Commission guidance published**: "Digital Batteries Passport — data point by category", splitting data points into those required from February 2027, those required only in particular circumstances, those not required in February 2027, and those applying only to particular battery types.
- **Still in draft**: the implementing act on access to restricted passport data (Ares(2026)9814179). Public consultation ran 19 October to 16 November 2026; adoption planned for Q4 2026. Annex XIII point 1 is public, point 3 is limited to notified bodies, market surveillance authorities and the Commission, and points 2 and 4 await this act.
- **Not yet triggered**: the carbon footprint declaration and A–E class labelling dates run on a "later of" rule keyed to the carbon-footprint methodology delegated act, which has not been adopted. The Commission states carbon footprint, recycled content and due diligence information are not required when passports launch on 18 February 2027.
- **Operational facts**: Registry helpdesk open 08:00–20:00 CET since 20 July 2026; test environment `registry.acc.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`; the battery passport registration identifier is not entered in the electronic customs declaration (that is an ESPR obligation); operator verification lasts no longer than three years.
- **Source**: Commission battery DPP FAQ https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/single-market/digital-product-passport/eu-digital-product-passport-faq-batteries_en

## Commercial Delivery Models
1. **Managed Sovereign Cloud Subscription (SaaS)**: 10-year Frankfurt ISO/IEC 27001 data vault hosting, 99.9% uptime SLA guarantee, automated rolling regulatory schema updates, Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) trade secret protection, and global GS1 Digital Link 2D resolution.
2. **Enterprise On-Premise Turnkey Suite**: Private cloud / on-premise deployment, full code and data sovereignty, zero per-scan fees, native read-only MES / ERP / PLM / BMS connectors, historical data cleansing, and on-site commissioning.
3. **Early Adopter Pilot Program**: Pre-validation sandbox for 1–3 battery pack SKUs, field gap audit, and DG GROW Registry pre-filing.
